text: incoherent implicit data access An implicit read access or an implicit write access which does not belong to a coherency group. Therefore it is NOT referenced by any RteVariableReadAccessRef or RteVariableWriteAccessRef belonging to a RteImplicitCommunication container which RteCoherentAccess parameter is set to true.
